def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) >= h + w)
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == sep for x in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [w]
    special = next(v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if v != sep and v != 7)
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rb) - 1):
        line = []
        for ci in range(len(cb) - 1):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == special
                        for r in range(rb[ri] + 1, rb[ri + 1])
                        for c in range(cb[ci] + 1, cb[ci + 1]))
            line.append(1 if count == 2 else 7)
        out.append(line)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    full_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    full_cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = grid[full_rows[0]][0] if full_rows else grid[0][full_cols[0]]

    # The background is the most frequent color other than the divider.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != sep)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked = next((color for color, n in counts.most_common()
                   if color != background), None)

    rb = [-1] + full_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + full_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rb) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(cb) - 1):
            cells = [grid[r][c]
                     for r in range(rb[ri] + 1, rb[ri + 1])
                     for c in range(cb[ci] + 1, cb[ci + 1])]
            row.append(1 if marked is not None and cells.count(marked) == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
